Major expenditure patterns include Education  K-12 Funding ($400B), Direct Transfer  Citizen Benefit ($400B), and Transport  Highway Projects ($380B). Bond Issuance heavily supports Transport infrastructure, while Defense receives substantial funding for Military Operations. The budget demonstrates balanced allocation across key sectors with education and infrastructure receiving significant attention.

Budget is balanced across key sectors
